result.detail: No assume statements, so the inputs are constrained minimally. DC-RANGE is placed under a reset-seen flag rather than an assumed reset, because the RTL has no initial value for count. The DC-COUNT step assertion is guarded by $past(count) < LIMIT, so it never claims behaviour that is unspecified before reset; after reset, DC-RANGE makes that guard equivalent to count != LIMIT. All assertions are immediate statements in always blocks, the subset the open Yosys front end reads. Their guards are plain if chains, so the antecedent derivation of formal.cover can place a cover on each path. The prove mode and the depth are read from the setup by the gate. formal.cover reuses smtbmc and depth 110, which is why abc pdr was not chosen. A mutant that loses the wrap or the carry only after 100 enabled cycles is caught by the DC-COUNT wrap and DC-CARRY assertions in the unbounded proof, not by a bounded unroll. Independent review is still required before approval.
